text: Timeframe: D. The trigger fires on a daily close above pivot_high, not an hourly poke; close_vs_swing_high_pct -0.86 sits just under the high 22.07, and C17/C19 ask for a clearing that holds, not a return to the level. day_vol figure: my method sets none. day_vol is a proxy, fill difficulty NOT_SERVED (R5), so I defer the line to the volume seats and do not object to day_vol 1.40 on that D close. The BOS on day_vol 0.5 I note: no fast follow-through after the clear is itself my danger signal (C17). Clears for me: close_above:pivot_high on D.
